// runtime helpers: $chk53, lean_nat_add$nnn

function $chk53(x) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(x)) {
    throw new RangeError("LeanScript: integer overflow: the result does not fit in a number (use the bigint representation)");
  }
  return x;
}

function lean_nat_add$nnn(a, b) {
  return $chk53((a + b));
}

// bump
export const bump = (n) => {
  return lean_nat_add$nnn(n, 1);
};
